title: The GojoHUB New Foundation Script
features:
The GojoHUB Foundation Script is a script hub interface designed for modifying or automating game functions. It features a clean, dark-themed layout with three main tabs:

Foundation Mods Scripts – Contains foundational or core script options.

Lobbys Scripts – Likely includes scripts related to lobby settings or game setup.

Others Hubs – Possibly links or integrates other script hubs.

Under the selected Foundation Mods Scripts tab, three script options are listed:

Auto Rooms With HUB – Likely automates room creation or management.

Tester Tab click ; to Open – Suggests a test feature that opens something when clicked.

Locked Rooms Script – Possibly manages or unlocks restricted rooms.
